raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
Depends on #50494; must not merge before #50494. This PR is based on #50494 and will be rebased onto `main` after #50494 merges, leaving only the Kimi-K3 follow-up commit.

## Purpose

#50494 adds member-identity routing for pipeline-parallel NIXL push with attention-only HMA layouts. It still explicitly rejects `PP > 1` when the hybrid KV cache contains Mamba/SSM state.

Kimi-K3 uses unified physical cache pages shared by KDA (Mamba/SSM) and MLA layers. This PR extends the member-identity framework from #50494 to:

- route PP-sharded Kimi KDA+MLA members to the corresponding full-model consumer regions;
- build member-major MLA and Mamba conv/SSM descriptors;
- preserve kernel-block geometry for MLA and logical-state geometry for SSM;
- keep decode-side PP and missing, duplicate, ambiguous, or inconsistent member identities fail-closed.

## Test Plan

Run the Kimi member-routing tests:

```bash
python -m pytest -q \
  tests/v1/kv_connector/unit/test_nixl_member_transfer.py \
  tests/v1/kv_connector/unit/test_nixl_push_connector.py \
  -k "member"
```

Run the NIXL connector regression gate:

```bash
python -m pytest -q \
  tests/v1/kv_connector/unit/test_nixl_member_transfer.py \
  tests/v1/kv_connector/unit/test_nixl_connector_hma.py \
  tests/v1/kv_connector/unit/test_nixl_push_connector.py \
  tests/v1/kv_connector/unit/test_nixl_desc_geometry.py \
  -k "not test_fewer_blocks_with_hma"
```

Run formatting and lint checks:

```bash
ruff check \
  vllm/distributed/kv_transfer/kv_connector/v1/nixl/base_worker.py \
  vllm/distributed/kv_transfer/kv_connector/v1/nixl/push_worker.py \
  tests/v1/kv_connector/unit/test_nixl_member_transfer.py \
  tests/v1/kv_connector/unit/test_nixl_push_connector.py

ruff format --check \
  vllm/distributed/kv_transfer/kv_connector/v1/nixl/base_worker.py \
  vllm/distributed/kv_transfer/kv_connector/v1/nixl/push_worker.py \
  tests/v1/kv_connector/unit/test_nixl_member_transfer.py \
  tests/v1/kv_connector/unit/test_nixl_push_connector.py
```

Run the existing PP2 NIXL push accuracy smoke with a Qwen3-0.6B PP2 producer and TP2 consumer:

```bash
KV_CONNECTOR=NixlPushConnector \
GPU_MEMORY_UTILIZATION=0.35 \
PREFILLER_PP_SIZE=2 \
PREFILLER_TP_SIZE=1 \
DECODER_TP_SIZE=2 \
MODEL_NAMES=Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B \
VLLM_SERVE_EXTRA_ARGS="--max-model-len,2048" \
bash tests/v1/kv_connector/nixl_integration/run_accuracy_test.sh
```

## Test Result

- Kimi/member-routing tests: `17 passed, 37 deselected`
- NIXL connector regression gate: `314 passed, 1 deselected`
- PP2 NIXL push accuracy smoke: `1 passed`
- Ruff lint: passed
- Ruff format check: passed

The available 8×MI355X host cannot simultaneously hold a Kimi-K3 producer and consumer. Therefore, this PR does not claim a Kimi-K3 end-to-end PD or performance result. The Kimi-specific path is covered by pooled-region routing, descriptor-ID, SSM geometry, and WRITE byte-range unit tests.

---
<details>
<summary> Essential Elements of an Effective PR Description Checklist </summary>

- [x] The purpose of the PR, including its dependency on #50494.
- [x] The test plan, including the exact test commands.
- [x] The test results, including unit and PP2 accuracy smoke results.
- [x] Documentation impact considered; no user-facing documentation change is required because this extends an existing connector path.

</details>
